CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF TRINITY CAPITAL CORPORATION HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT E & W AUTO REPAIR,INC. SOLOMON, WILLARD POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: SEE IN TEXT, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $6,086.74 DAMAGES, $950.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $235.30 COSTS, $101.87 AS INTERESTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,373.91, LEASED EQUIPMENT: ONE MTS 5100 ENGINE ANALYZER KIT DELUXE, WHICH EQUIPMENT HAS A FAIR MARKET VALUE OF $2000 AND IS ENTITLED TO ITS IMMEDIATE POSSESSION, IF PLTF. OBTAINS POSSESSION OF AND SELLS PROPERTY, DEFT. SHALL RECEIVE ALL CREDITS TO WHICH THEY ARE ENTITLED BY LAW, SEE JUDGMENT AT LENGTH AND SCANNED DOCUMENT.
